svg.title: MaldiDeepKit: four deep-learning backbones, one scikit-learn API
svg.desc: Animated diagram. A binned MALDI-TOF spectrum (6000 bins, 2,000 to 20,000 m/z) is routed in turn through each of the four MaldiDeepKit backbones: an MLP (fully connected layers), a 1-D CNN (a convolution kernel sliding over the spectrum into feature maps), a 1-D ResNet (convolution blocks with skip connections) and a 1-D Vision Transformer (spectrum patches turned into tokens linked by self-attention). The active backbone is highlighted and its schematic animates, then the predicted antimicrobial-resistance probabilities update (illustrative values: MLP 0.82 Resistant / 0.18 Susceptible, 1-D CNN 0.88 / 0.12, 1-D ResNet 0.91 / 0.09, 1-D ViT 0.86 / 0.14). All four share the same scikit-learn fit / predict_proba API. The animation loops every 12 seconds.
